screen_policy: Every slide must prove the exact copy through visible Aachu/Zuv behavior. Any doubtful slide blocks image generation until repaired and re-reviewed.

slide_reviews.copy: You’re missing from so many of my memories.
You were there when I chose courage.
You made me visible from places no one could see.
You held the world outside for a minute.
You never made love the reason I stayed behind.
Sometimes the person missing from your memories is the person who made them possible.

director_storyboard.copy_lock_evidence: The creator approved the exact seven slide lines before the repaired observable-only review payload was created.
director_storyboard.reviewer_evidence: A fresh orchestrated critic received only revised observable staged cards and reported the archive imbalance, off-crop partner presence, invisible authorship, and final correction before seeing copy or intent.
